title: Hoist the child-list sort out of the per-curriculum loop in ContentTree.fromCurricula

evidence.quote:
// Sort each child list by sortOrder so display is stable.
      for (final list in childrenByContainerKey.values) {

why: The sort block at lines 126-129 iterates `childrenByContainerKey.values` — the map accumulated across ALL curricula processed so far — but it sits inside the outer `for (final entry in byCurriculum.entries)` loop (opens line 93, the sort closes at line 130 still inside it). For 9 curricula this re-sorts every earlier curriculum's already-sorted child lists up to 9 times each instead of once. contentTree is a keepAlive provider built synchronously (no isolate offload) the first time any screen reads it, so this redundant O(9x) work sits directly on that first-access latency, not merely a style nit.
recommendation: Move the sort block outside the curriculum loop (one dedent) so each child list is sorted exactly once after all curricula are indexed.
acceptance_criteria: The sort loop executes once, after the curriculum loop, in content_tree.dart.
Existing children()-ordering assertions in epic_25_schema_core_test.dart continue to pass.
